title: Day 1 of YOLOing $10k on my CloutChaser v4 strategy
author: CloutChaserv4
selftext:
I developed CloutChaser v4, a regime-gated, monthly momentum rotation strategy based on the work of Jegadeesh, Titman, Moskowitz and the good folks at AQR Capital. It basically dick-rides the top 8 stocks from a universe of 45 candidates ranked by trailing 12-1 month returns, holds the top 8 in equal weight, and moves to cash when the broader market's goes bad. There's obviously more to it than that, but you get the idea.

This is my first time actually using AI to help me test and tweak a trading strategy. I went through three different versions before landing on v4. I also tried a v5 that addressed some issues with v4, but the results were not as good so v4 is what's getting deployed. I've backtested the crap out of the model and the results looked promising, but I'm sure there's something I'm still missing. Nevertheless I thought it would be funny to try it out with real money.

Day 1 holdings: $1250 each to AAPL, CAT, CSCO, GOOGL, JNJ, LLY, MRK & UNH and the portfolio is already getting hammered. 😂😭

comments.author: krazineurons
comments.body:
How much back in time did you back test it? Is it entirely generated by AI? Does it have an Edge? My researcher has found 0 edges so far and that is scanning from 75+ strategies, so just wondering.. 

God speed btw!

replies.author: CloutChaserv4
replies.body:
Thanks! I'm only using publicly available free data, so I had some trouble getting full reliable numbers before 2000. I ran several backtests, going all the way back to 2000 on some, 2010 on others.

The strategy is entirely AI-generated, other than the fact that I'm an actual financial professional with a decade of experience and I've been guiding things throughout.

Here's a [5-year rolling alpha graph (SPY regime)](https://i.imgur.com/iv7jSDT.jpeg) for the strategy since 2010.
